name: Filebrowser
description: Browse, share and upload files from a Filebrowser instance straight from Mattermost slash commands.

settings_schema.header: Filebrowser plugin settings. The URL below must point at a reachable Filebrowser instance. Individual users authenticate themselves with `/filebrowser connect` — their credentials are never visible to the admin.
settings_schema.footer: Plugin icon: file-browser icon from heroicons.

settings.help_text: Base URL of your Filebrowser instance, e.g. `https://files.example.com`. No trailing slash.
